products.product: ProTaper VDS Bar Mounts 02-26 Honda CRF450R/ 04-24 CRF450R - 022218

fits.notes: Fitment is only in the maker's product title '02-26 Honda CRF450R/ 04-24 CRF450R' (https://protaper.com/protaper-vds-bar-mounts-02-26-honda-crf450r-04-24-crf450r-022218/). No separate fitment table on the page.

products.what_it_changes: VDS (Vibration Damping System) bar mounts. A tuned elastomer system isolates handlebar vibration, which ProTaper says reduces arm pump. Damps in both compression and rebound, with a dedicated rebound spacer. Ships with three interchangeable elastomers to tune softness and feel. Fits 1-1/8 in. handlebars.
products.supporting_parts: Needs a 1-1/8 in. (fat) handlebar. A fitted bar pad comes in the box.
products.caveats: The title repeats 'CRF450R' with two year ranges (02-26 and 04-24). The second may be meant as another model (probably CRF250R), but the page does not say, so only CRF450R is listed here. No heights, offsets or colors are printed. The page showed the item as out of stock on 2026-10-17. CRF450RX is not named.

gaps: Handlebars (ProTaper, Neken) have no per-bike or year fitment on the maker pages. ProTaper's 'Check Fit' selector needs JavaScript and could not be read, so the bar products have empty fits. Bend names such as 'Husqvarna Stock', 'Factory Suzuki/KTM Stock', 'Original YZF', 'Original RMZ' and '250/450 CRF KXF' name a model family with no years.

ProTaper VDS 022217: the title says only 'KTM 125-500/ Gas Gas/ Husqvarna' for 2023-26. Only the KTM SX models are listed in fits; KTM XC/XC-W, the GasGas MC/EX/EC and Husqvarna TC/FC/FX/TE models of 2023-26 are not itemized by the maker.

ProTaper VDS 022218: the title 'Honda CRF450R/ 04-24 CRF450R' repeats a model and may mean CRF250R 2004-24; the page does not say. VDS 022215 Yamaha shows conflicting years (21-27 heading vs 14-26 title). VDS 022216 Kawasaki covers only up to 2024 and does not name the KX250X/KX450X.
ProTaper Fuzion: the product page lists no clamp size or colours. Sport bars: no dimensions for the track-named bends. Bend chart: no pullback column on any family.

Neken triple clamps (Standard, SFS air, SFS Spring): the maker site lists fitment only up to 2019 (e.g. SFS Spring KTM SX-SXF 2013-2019 22 mm 0509060, CRF 250/450 2018/2019 0309027, YZF 250/450 2018/2019 0409043). No 2020+ roster fitment is published, so no clamp products were recorded. SFS Spring: 10 mm travel, 22 mm offset, 28.6 mm bar clamp, 7075-T6.
Neken's site appears frozen at about 2019 (its catalogue link is the 2019 Parts Europe pageflip). Current Neken 2020+ fitment probably lives in the Parts Europe catalogue, which needs JavaScript.

TAG Metals: the moto line seems to be wound down. TAG's live site (tagmtb.com) sells only MTB parts, and US retailers (BTO Sports) mark TAG moto bars and mounts 'discontinued'. Retailer listings (motostorm.it) show T1/T2/T3 bars and 'Hon/Kaw 1 1/8 100/200/300 Bar Mounts' with no part numbers or years. Nothing recorded.

Applied Racing (moto triple clamps): the Chapmoto R/S Mount set listing (SKU 08-6362SSR family, offsets 18/20/21/21.5/22/24 mm, Silver/Red/Blue/Black) shows fitment only up to 2014. No 2020+ fitment found. Nothing recorded.
